Born in Detroit , Eisley played college basketball at Boston College and was drafted in 1994 by the Minnesota Timberwolves . Eisley spent twelve seasons in the NBA , six with the Utah Jazz ( 1995 -- 2000 , 2004 -- 2005 ) and the other six with seven other teams .

[P3] Journey to the Center of Time
Journey to the Center of Time is a 1967 U.S. science fiction film , directed by David L. Hewitt , and starring Scott Brady and Anthony Eisley . It is a remake of The Time Travelers ( 1964 ) , and was also known as Time Warp .

[P4] The Valley (Eisley album)

[P5] Freight Train Heart
